blocks.text: ABOARD AIR FORCE ONE — US President Donald Trump was heading to Asia on Monday, turning his focus to economic deals and historic three-way nuclear talks with Russia and China as his administration adjusts to a new political reality in Washington. He said he may meet with Kim Jong Un while in China as the U.S. looks to reengage North Korea on its nuclear program. Trump also said he plans to talk about Russia’s nearly 5-year-old war in Ukraine during his highly anticipated meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian leader Vladimir Putin in China.
